source: Pinned Blender5.3 macOSarm64 CPU compositor literal QuaternionToRotation/RotationToQuaternion. Private Geometry Nodes CPU-MF result is independently compared to unchanged actual CPU compositor output. No native GPU or shader claim.
inputs: Each original raw Float32 W/X/Y/Z word is +0 or abs>=2^-16 with abs<=4. No unlinked ROTATION defaults/implicit casts, computed/recombined components, fields or animation; ROTATION stays opaque.
wordContract: Every native component word, private-MF output, emitted VALUE constant and actual browser RGBA channel must match exactly. Alpha is exact1. No tolerance, sign normalization, epsilon or input quantization.
zeroAndSignControls: All-zero quaternion gives identity(1,+0,+0,+0); positive/negative W/X/Y/Z basis vectors at scales2^-16,1,4 use manually declared word goldens. Negative W remains negative; unchanged zeros must remain positive zero.
normality: Nonzero squared norm is between2^-32 and64; finite positive length/reciprocal cannot underflow bounded nonzero components. Output raw words are checked before float promotion; unexpected -0/subnormal/nonfinite words refuse.
runtime: Existing VALUE constants only; no ROTATION/MATRIX opcode, GPU normalization, runtime texture/readback or new pass.
